svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Azure Virtual Desktop North Star architecture
svg.desc: Users sign in with Microsoft Entra ID and connect through Azure Virtual Desktop. A pooled host pool of Microsoft Entra joined session hosts on ephemeral OS disks reverse connects to the service, is created and updated by session host configuration and autoscale, uses images from Azure Compute Gallery and policy from Microsoft Intune, reads profiles and App Attach packages from Azure Files over a private endpoint, and sends telemetry to Azure Monitor.
svg.text: Diagnostics, performance data, AVD Insights and alerts
